focus_areas: Texture fidelity of wing scales vs. white patches.
Physical grounding of legs on the stem.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the micro-texture of the butterfly wings. Real macro photography should show individual scales or a consistent granular noise pattern. AI images often smooth out these details, especially in lighter colored areas. Also, verify if the 'fuzziness' of the thorax looks like natural hair or generated noise. Crucially, inspect the contact points between the legs and the green stem to ensure there is no 'floating' or unnatural blending.
image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a Ringlet butterfly (Aphantopus hyperantus) perched vertically on a green plant stem. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a soft brown coloration with distinct white patches and small black eyespots (ocelli). The body is fuzzy/hairy and brown. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green.
